goal: Diagnose DATASET sparsity and NER role/boundary errors on the existing training cohort before another model change.
scope: Read only train references/receipts/NER rows. Verify other sealed files with binary hashes only. Infer all 50 eligible train papers with both frozen models using label-free features, then score separately.
sourceReview: Before seeing new train predictions, inspect all 16 DATASET-bearing whole train abstracts. Record source-bound AI judgments and same-session self-review; not independent gold, not a new annotation receipt. No label edits in this diagnostic round.
errorPolicy: Exact span/type matches are TP; every unmatched reference/prediction counted once. Type mismatch first if identical span, otherwise overlap gives boundary or type_and_boundary; no overlap gives missing/extra. Overlap categories are geometric diagnostics, not semantic correctness decisions.
nextExperimentRule: Use train-only support, token counts and error/source review to choose one bounded follow-up. Do not pick phrases from dev/test, retune thresholds, or claim training fit as new accuracy.
